For each account, information about the user and the current balance is stored. The method for checking the current account balance should be provided in the Account class. Users can make transactions on their accounts. For each transaction, the related account, the amount and the type of transaction (payment or deposit) should be indicated. Then, the new balance state is printed.

question.en: Draw a class diagram describing the operation of a library. The library has books and magazines. For books, data about the title, inventory number, number of pages, and number of copies are stored. For the authors, name, surname and year of birth are kept. For the magazines, the title, the inventory number, the journal number, and the number of copies are kept. The library has many members. Each member is described by his/her name and surname, address of residence and membership number. There are multiple book copies. For each copy, the number and status (whether the copy is rented) are kept. One member can borrow up to 5 copies. For borrowing a book, the borrowing date of the book or magazine, the date of return and the status of the borrowing (completed or active) is kept. Provide methods for creating a new borrowing, closing the borrowing, changing the author of the book and a method for returning the book or magazine.

Warehouses store products, and each product's name and code are kept and the product stocks available in the warehouse. Upon the arrival of the proforma invoice, the company creates internal orders that provide the required products. One order refers to one warehouse (it is not necessary to have orders for all warehouses of the company). If a given product is available in any warehouse, an item is inserted for that product (and the requested amount). For any order, besides the item's info, the proforma invoice, and the warehouse, information on the order number and the date created is stored.

question.en: Draw a class diagram for the work organization in a company. Each company is composed of departments, with each department having several sub-departments. For each department, information should be kept about the department's name, the head of the department, and the number of employees. For each office, data about the office address, as well as the phone number should be kept. Several departments of the company can be located in the same office. The employees are described by their name and surname, personal identification number, date of employment, salary points, as well as their salary. Each of the employees at some point can be (or not) engaged in a task. If somebody is currently engaged, it should be known when he/she started to work on the task, the deadline to complete the task, and the priority of the task. For the tasks, the name of the task, short description, and status of the task should be kept (started, ongoing or completed). Provide methods that will check whether an employee works in a given department, whether the employee is the head of a particular department, and whether the employee is working on a task that has exceeded the deadline for completion.
